messages:
tara: quick feedback on the new chart in Console — y-axis feels noisy with small values, and the unit placement is confusing :eyes:
alex: can you screenshot? are you seeing `ms` as the axis label or as a tick suffix?
maria: +1 on confusion. right now the axis shows `Latency (ms)` but ticks are `0, 50, 100` => users have to infer units. suggest moving unit to tick suffix (e.g., 0ms, 50ms) OR show compact suffix like 0k/1M for counts.
sam: for time-based metrics i prefer the unit in the label, but for mixed-series charts tick suffix helps with quick skimming. maybe make it configurable per metric type and default per-data-type?
josh: related: smoothing toggle default should be OFF for SLO charts. smoothing hides spikes which are important for alerts. put the toggle near the top-right of the chart, small label: `Smoothing: off` with tooltip copy: "Spline smoothing hides short spikes; enable for trend view."
tara: good call. also outlier handling — current approach clips at max which compresses mid-range. options: 1) clip + indicator, 2) break axis (good for distrib view), 3) allow zoom to include outliers. prefer clip + mini-histogram inset to show outlier distribution.
maria: accessibility nit: series legend rows need explicit aria-labels like `Series: redis p99 latency` not just color. and keyboard focus ring on legend items is missing.
alex: color contrast — the grey series for internal ops doesn't pass AA at small sizes. either bump saturation or add patterned legend swatches for color-blind.
josh: microcopy tweak suggestion for tooltip: instead of "value" use "Median latency (p50): 42 ms" — be explicit about stat and unit.
sam: UX decision: default smoothing off, ticks show suffix for numeric metrics, legend items get aria-labels, add pattern option for color-blind safe teams, clip outliers but show inset summary.
tara: action items: @alex update axis unit toggle copy + add mockup, @maria add aria labels and keyboard focus, @josh wire tooltip copy and inset mini-histogram design, @sam update design doc with defaults. I'll create a follow-up PR with visuals. :thumbsup:
design-bot: Reminder — design review scheduled Thu 11am. Agenda: axis units, smoothing default, outlier inset.
tara: thanks — will bring mocks.
